component.name: dnsrace
component.summary: Find and apply the fastest DNS resolver for your connection

description.p: dnsrace measures public DNS resolvers from your own connection and ranks them by cached and uncached lookup latency. It supports plain DNS over UDP or TCP, DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS, checks DNSSEC behaviour and NXDOMAIN hijacking, and can optionally show where hostnames are steered.

ul.li: Test every built-in resolver or only the servers you select.
Compare popular-domain latency with uncached lookups, jitter and timeouts.
Apply the winner on Linux, Windows or macOS, with a saved state for reverting.
Keep a local run history and export JSON, CSV or HTML reports.
No telemetry, no account and no background service.

description.p: First release of the GUI-only desktop application, with DoT, expanded DoH providers, DNSSEC checks, history, exports and system DNS apply/revert.
